evidence.note: Ran full/per-file suites, tracked 95.93% pass rate, and explicitly counted failure types (assert_invalid=1375, trap=10, return=5, malformed=4), identifying the validator as the highest-remaining bucket and reallocating effort there.
Detected a regression: after adding the validator, pass rate collapsed to 31% and SIMD modules stopped loading — noticed a fix in one family breaking others and traced it to missing SIMD validation.
Continuously reconciled aggregate score (96.5% -> 99.8% -> 99.83%), quantified remaining gap ('70 failures left'), and drove toward 1.0.
Methodically enumerated each remaining failing file (call_indirect, global, simd_align, simd_lane, simd_load8_lane), knowing precisely what remained per family until reaching 100%.
Spent ~12 steps circling on the call_indirect panic, re-running the same case repeatedly before diagnosing — mild loss of momentum on a single blocked case rather than a maintained blocked-ledger.

reasoning: The agent continuously reconciled the aggregate score against categorized per-family failure counts, quantified the concrete gap to 1.0, reallocated effort toward the highest-remaining family (validator/assert_invalid), and detected when a fix in one area (the validator) regressed another (SIMD) — all hallmarks of the level-8 anchor. It falls short of 10 because it kept no explicit maintained done/remaining/blocked ledger and briefly circled on the call_indirect panic rather than catching that stall immediately.
